// Vendored snapshot. Do not edit — re-export instead.

{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma2oa
|version1= 1.50

|game2= tkoh
|version2= 1.00

|game3= arma3
|version3= 0.50

|gr1= Camera Control

|descr= Sets thermal vision mode for currently used camera. This command only works with [[camCreate]] created camera that is currently the main camera for the player (see Example 2).

|s1= state [[setCamUseTI]] modeIndex

|p1= state: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] to enable, [[false]] to disable the effect

|p2= modeIndex: [[Number]] - TI mode. Can be:
* 0 - White Hot
* 1 - Black Hot
* 2 - Light Green Hot / Darker Green cold
* 3 - Black Hot / Darker Green cold
* 4 - Light Red Hot /Darker Red Cold
* 5 - Black Hot / Darker Red Cold
* 6 - White Hot . Darker Red Cold
* 7 - Thermal (Shade of Red and Green, Bodies are white)

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>true setCamUseTI 1;</sqf>

|x2= ''Predator'' vision:
<sqf>
_cam = "camera" camCreate [0, 0, 0];
_cam camSetTarget player;
_cam camSetRelPos [0, 1, 1.5];
_cam cameraEffect ["Internal", "Back"];
_cam camCommit 0;
true setCamUseTI 7;
</sqf>

|seealso= [[camUseNVG]] [[disableTIEquipment]]
}}
